[(1)āsu+visa.āsa]  CL=7 A venomous snake whose poison is as sharp as a four-edged blade. Whatever it eats turns entirely into poison, making it a creature known for storing deadly venom at its fangs.
[Sīghaṃ etassa visaṃ āgacchatīti āsī(si)viso. Vi,ṭṭha,1.184. Ussībyañjane. Āsīviso. Nīti,sutta. 177.(2)āsitta+visa.(3)asita+visa.(4)asisadisa+visa. Saṃ,ṭṭha,3.54. Sārattha,2.22.(5)āsī+visa. Āsīti vā dāṭhā vuccati. Tattha sannihitavisoti āsīviso. Sārattha,2.22. Āsiyaṃvisaṃ etassāti āsīviso, āsīsappadāṭhā. Dhāna,ṭī,653.(āgīvipa-saṃ)]
āsīvisadaṭṭha: [Āsīvisa+daṭṭha] (ti) CL=8 who is bitten by snake; he.
āsīvisadaṭṭhūpamā: [Āsīvisadaṭṭha+upamā] (thī) CL=8 For example, a person who is bitten by a snake.
āsīvisapūritavammika: [Āsīviya+pūrita+vammika] (pu) CL=8 A mound full of snakes.
āsīvisālayasama: [Āsīvisa+ālaya+sama] (ti) CL=8 Like the place where snakes live.
āsīvisūpama: [Āsīvisa+upamā] (ti) CL=8 Similar to the example of a snake.
āsīvādana: [Āsī+vādana] (na) CL=8 Longing for the desired benefit; Rewards. Āsivāda - see also
āsavasavarapariyāya: [Āsavasaṃvara+pariyāya] (pu) CL=8 cause of restriction of Āsava.
āsasa: [Ā+saṃsa+a] (ti) CL=8 (1) who is longing ; he. (Thi) (2) Desire.
āsasamāna: [Ā+saṃsa+a+māna] (ti) CL=8 Who wanted; he. Āsaṃsa - (1) - See.
āsasati: [Ā+saṃsa+a+ti] (kri) CL=8 who longed for. Āsī(si) Mindfulness - See also.
āsasuka: [Āsaṃsu+ka] (ti) CL=8 who is longing for; he.
āsādetu: [Ā+sada+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=8 To insult, slander, torture, insult and offend.
āsāditu: [Ā+sada+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=8 To approach (to destroy virtues). Āsāduṃ - Look.
